extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Smallest positive integer divisible by each of a set of integers.

extracted_concepts.name: Equations

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Solid shapes represented using nets or fractional edge lengths.

extracted_concepts.name: Nets

extracted_concepts.name: Statistical Question
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Question anticipated to yield variability in data when answered.

extracted_concepts.name: Data Distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Summary and description of how data values are spread or clustered.

extracted_concepts.name: Measures of Center
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Statistics like mean or median that identify the central point of a dataset.

extracted_concepts.name: Measures of Variation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Statistics like range or interquartile range describing data spread.
